carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregularities and minor notches are visible along the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral flank of the shark.
